display_name: WiSig 已知模拟噪声监督的 Full 星地正式测试
description: Fit two independently frozen estimators on the same WiSig source U_s Practical Full pairs and formally evaluate both plus matched archived raw/R69 controls on the complete clean and six-view Full matrix. Match regional edit norms to the source-only FIR teacher in one arm, and learn the full additive noise reference in the other.
authorization: User requested real frozen Full satellite benchmark results for both matched models on both datasets.

code.environment: N607 existing WiSig release Python and frozen reader precision

data.version: Main 25 MS/s post_sync/noeq, native 256 complex samples
data.representation: 256 complex points, frozen reader canonical input
data.contract_ref: Exact source-U and Full manifests, registered cross_rx / cross_both; no simultaneous-source/test physical IDs
data.physical_ids_ref: U_s 20512 legal source rows; Full 126000 cross_rx and 42000 cross_both physical IDs in frozen readers' order
data.label_map_ref: Archive Main classifier mapping; truth opened by separate CPU scorer only after both Full prediction files freeze
data.validation_ref: Prior validation and exact parent cache manifests

permissions.query_use: Prediction only, packet IQ, no target truth or target simulator components, independently scored afterward
permissions.claim_scope: Full simulated satellite-terrestrial recognition with exact additive supervision on legal independent source simulation only.

checkpoint.initialization: Two random initializations from same seed, no pretrained restorer initialization

sources.role: Frozen source-only teacher supplies regional edit L2 norms for direction_only fit
Three frozen default recognition heads used only after fit
Archived matched Full predictions for formal comparison only

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Native source 25 MS/s PostSync noEQ and original exposure; exact archive replay receipts for target controls
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source teacher and target readers use matching native 256 contract
checkpoint.selection_rule: Freeze terminal step 24000 for both arms independently of source holdout and target results; evaluate both.

execution.gpu_policy: Two workers at most across the preregistered eligible GPUs, at most one worker from this run per card; count incumbent training processes under the current per-card limit
execution.stop_rule: Systemic permission/split/physical-ID/count/frozen receipt mismatch, nonfinite values, owner output collision or same pre-prediction worker failure. Preserve intermediates and both negative results.

metric_names: correct counts and accuracy by seven views

notes: The two Full target splits use same physical input order and frozen direct/R69 control outputs.

The source simulator creates receive pairs and the source target only. The formal recovery forward takes received 256-point IQ; formal target generator actions/noise and clean references are unavailable to it.
Every model is scored across both splits, all three frozen readers and all seven views.

rows.method: Matched center/edge dose, known noise direction supervision
rows.seed_notes: WiSig fixed Main split and frozen Full draw inherited from matched controls. Recognition seeds 2026092701 through 03. No support draws.
rows.budget_ref: 24000 steps, batch 32, 8 additional clean identity examples per batch; fixed terminal checkpoint; 168000 physical packets per seed through seven views
